purpose: Recognize and stabilize a map name without allowing minimap ornaments to become OCR glyphs.

inputContract.mapNameRoi: Exact map_name_screen_roi crop from the client frame; no padding.
inputContract.rawText: string from the sanitized OpenText fallback only

sampleMatch.reason: The accepted samples include fixed frame ornaments; resizing a pad=1 crop destroys pixel-mask IoU.

openTextFallback.reason: Exclude the fixed ornament at x=0..37 and right-side controls starting near x=131 while retaining known long names.

20260705-140849-冰原.reason: Manual pixel review shows the rendered map name is 武夷; both raw and sanitized RapidOCR also return 武夷.

rules: Run sample_match on the exact ROI with padding=0 before OpenText.
Run OpenText only on the ornament-trimmed fallback crop.
Normalize Unicode and keep only CJK ideographs, ASCII letters and digits.
Accept OpenText only for an exact known name or an explicitly reviewed alias.
Do not accept 洛阳门, 洛阳7 or 洛阳司 as aliases after ornament trimming.
Do not use prefix containment or generic fuzzy matching.
Apply reviewed sampleLabelOverrides by sample id before policy evaluation.
Expose a stable canonical name only after at least 2 matching votes in the last 3 independent frames.
Unknown or unstable output must not reach a routing state machine as a confirmed map.
